# Blavity

> > Blavity is a premier Black media network delivering entertainment, culture, and lifestyle news for the African diaspora community.

Blavity operates multiple verticals including Shadow and Act (entertainment), AfroTech (technology and business), Travel Noire (travel), 21Ninety (lifestyle), and Home & Texture (home and design), serving as a comprehensive digital platform for Black culture and perspectives.

## Key Topics

- Shadow and Act
- AfroTech
- Travel Noire
- 21Ninety
- Home & Texture
- African diaspora
- Black media
- Entertainment news
- Film and television
- Celebrity news
- Black culture
- Howard University
- Boston Celtics
- Virgin River

## Entertainment & Culture

- [Shadow And Act - Blavity News](https://blavity.com/entertainment/?p=4923): Shadow and Act entertainment news covering African diaspora cinema & TV
